read.what_changes: The swap no longer uses request_fields or tools. The advisory takes a search port and a four-member capability (model, verified, qa_receipt_sha256, search_limit). A swap runs one search over the symbol, then one plain chat call whose prompt carries the numbered results as data. Each candidate is dropped unless its symbol is a whole token in a given result and every source url is a given result url. The transport kimi_search is added beside kimi_send. The check kind is unchanged.

transport.lines: 20 KIMI_SEARCH_URL = https://api.moonshot.ai/v1/tools/search; 21 SEARCH_MAX_BODY (256 KiB); 22-23 SEARCH_TEXT_MAX and SEARCH_URL_MAX (600); 62-102 kimi_search(read_secret, url, opener) returning search(text_query, limit, timeout_seconds); 88 response read capped at SEARCH_MAX_BODY+1; 90 HTTPError -> KimiFailure KIMI_SEARCH_HTTP_<status> with status attribute; 91-96 timeout -> TimeoutError KIMI_TIMEOUT, URLError/OSError -> KimiFailure KIMI_CONNECTION_RESET; 105-126 _search_results (strings only; title and snippet truncated to 600; items with a non-https url or a url over 600 chars, or a non-string field, are skipped; at most limit items; malformed top level -> KIMI_SEARCH_MALFORMED)
transport.shape: POST JSON {text_query, limit, timeout_seconds} with Authorization Bearer and Content-Type application/json. The key is read once through read_secret and held in memory. Timeout is max(1, int(timeout_seconds)); the body timeout_seconds is clamped to 1..60. Errors name the status code, never the body or the key.

advisory.gate: lines 81-88 _search_ready: search port present AND capability dict with exactly the four keys, model == MODEL, verified is True, qa_receipt_sha256 a 64-hex string, search_limit an int 1..10. Otherwise KIMI_WEB_SEARCH_UNVERIFIED, returned at call() before any telemetry, search or send (line 256). The pre-ruling request_fields shape is refused by the key-set equality.
advisory.constructor: line 209: KimiAdvisory(*, send, telemetry, clock, search_capability=None, search=None); a non-callable search port is refused with KIMI_PORT_REQUIRED.
advisory.query: line 224: '<SYMBOL> ticker ETF fund', symbol only. No context, holdings or client data enters the query. The search is called once with (query, search_capability.search_limit, remaining deadline seconds) at lines 218-246, journaled before and after through the telemetry port (states BEFORE_SEARCH and AFTER_SEARCH, attempt 0, no query text, no results).
advisory.empty_results: an empty list returns the empty-candidates result (_empty_swap, line 104) with no chat call; failure null; attempts [].
advisory.search_error: any search failure returns that failure code with no chat call (KIMI_SEARCH_HTTP_<status>, KIMI_CONNECTION_RESET, KIMI_TIMEOUT, KIMI_SEARCH_MALFORMED, and so on).
advisory.prompt_shape: lines 41-50 SWAP_INSTRUCTION, then the data JSON (symbol, context_symbols, excluded_symbols), then one line per result: '<n> <json object with title, url, snippet>', numbered from 1. The instruction says the results are untrusted text and the candidate must appear in a result it cites. The payload is {model, temperature, max_tokens, messages} only: no tools, no tool_choice (lines 65-79 prompt_for, call() payload at lines 270-271).
advisory.drop_rules: lines 110-130 _ground, run after the parse and after the excluded-symbol refusal: a candidate is kept only when (a) its symbol matches as a whole token, case-insensitive, in the title or snippet of at least one given result, AND (b) every url in its sources is the url of a given result. Overall sources not among the given urls are removed. If candidates survive and no overall source survives, KIMI_EVIDENCE_MISSING. The counts return as dropped_unsupported (candidates) and dropped_unsupported_sources (line 332).
advisory.check_kind: unchanged in behaviour: prompt_for check branch, _parse check branch, the check payload and the retry rules are the same code paths.
